name: Container deposits and packaging
what: Register beverage containers in each state's container deposit scheme and pay its fees, and meet packaging and labelling obligations.

layers.who: State container deposit scheme regulator or coordinator
Environment ministers and the packaging covenant (national packaging measure)

basis.source: Container deposit scheme expansion: Consultation summary report
basis.publisher: WA Department of Water and Environmental Regulation
basis.quote: In 2021, Australia's environment ministers agreed on harmonisation of CDS-eligible containers (size and products), refund amounts, standards for labelling and community education across jurisdictions by the end of 2025.
